entities.title: Rust library tests
entities.summary: Cargo's integration tests: the shared fixture runners, the typed-layer and JSON-layer tests, the purity check, and the two example suites in their own folders.
entities.purpose: Checks the crate through its public API only. Each tests/*.rs file is one test target (everyday, text_form, conformance, validation_codes, typed, operations, purity); utv_first/ and native_first/ are two more, built from their main.rs, and fixtures/ is a module both of them include. The shared material in conformance/ and the demo rules are read from the repository, relative to CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR, never copied.
boundaries: Tests the crate as a dependency (use utv::...); the unit tests that need the crate's internals live next to the code in src/.
What each target checks is recorded in this folder's verification.json, and for the example suites in their own folders' verification.json.
Test results are readings and are not recorded here.
